prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "Select a pet persona to bring your desktop to life with unique animations and behaviors.", "Select Personality Trait"]
1: ["Preparing Desktop Environment", "Configuring desktop layer overlay and setting up pet spawn coordinates."]
2: ["Create Your Custom Desktop Pet", "Follow these steps to upload a clear photo for best desktop rendering quality.", "Photo Guidelines Checklist", "Upload Photo"]
3: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Give your desktop companion a name to begin your journey together."]
4: ["Sign in to securely link your pet to your cloud account and prevent loss of pet progress.", "Cloud Save Active: Your companion data will sync across sessions."]
5: ["Hatching Your Desktop Pet", "We are generating high-res desktop animations. You can minimize this window while we work."]
6: ["Your Companion is Ready on Your Desktop!", "Right-click your pet anytime to access settings, hide to tray, or start a chat.", "Quick Controls: Right click pet for menu | Drag to move | Double click to interact"]
7: ["Choose Your Pet Journey", "Select a path to unlock a free starter accessory pack for your new companion.", "Includes Free Starter Accessory Pack"]
8: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Sanctuary", "Your pet now lives on your screen. Use Ctrl+Shift+P to summon or send your pet to the system tray anytime.", "Launch Desktop Companion"]
9: ["Generating Desktop Animations..."]
